hook_text: You paid one rand of VAT on a cooldrink today. Here is exactly where it goes next.
clip_script: One rand of VAT goes to SARS and into the national pot. Then it splits. A piece pays your teacher and the meal at break. A piece buys vaccines at the clinic. A piece lands in your gogo's hand as her grant. A piece builds a house or puts water pipes into an informal settlement. A piece fixes a road or keeps the trains running. A piece pays the police officer driving past tonight. Education, health, grants, housing, transport, security: the six areas of government spending. And the seventh piece nobody talks about? Interest on government's debt, now as big as the whole health budget. Every rand that goes to lenders is a rand that does not build a clinic. That is opportunity cost, and it is why every February the budget is a fight.
visual_style: A whiteboard coin splitting along six arrows to a school, clinic, gogo, house, train and police badge, then a seventh arrow labelled interest growing thicker.
mood: Curious and a little dramatic, building to a sharp point about debt.
pacing: Six rapid stops, one pause on the seventh, a firm closing line.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and share out the budget pot yourself.
